epic_summary: Ship an unpacked Manifest V3 WXT/React extension and an authenticated HTTPS Hono proxy using Bun and the scaffold's OpenRouter integration (OpenAI-compatible chat completions with OPENROUTER_API_KEY from .env). The visible Side Panel accepts a natural-language task, shows a plan before Run, executes one validated browser action at a time, and presents progress, confirmation, Stop, and fresh completion evidence. The MVP is complete only when Wikipedia research with a reference tab and dummy-form preparation on httpbin both pass, safety/error tests pass, the proxy is reachable, and the prescribed demo finishes in under five minutes. Exclude arbitrary-site guarantees, background continuation, accounts, databases, payments, web/native applications, extra providers, debugger/screenshot control, iframe/shadow-root/canvas/PDF control, history/export, uploads/downloads, authentication/CAPTCHA automation, and Web Store submission.
epic_done_when: An independent Bun-based Sidekick scaffold builds an unpacked MV3 extension; its toolbar opens chrome.sidePanel and its authenticated HTTPS proxy uses a single server-fixed OpenRouter model model without exposing the provider key.

The panel presents task input, selected-tab context, token configuration, provider disclosure, a pre-execution plan, Run, labelled step states, confirmation, and Stop; it meets the prescribed borderless monochrome design and keyboard/320-pixel requirements.

Indexed, bounded, redacted top-frame snapshots ground read/find, scroll, click, ordinary fill, and open/switch-tab tools; every action validates its target identity and receives fresh observation, and unsafe actions cannot bypass extension-side policy.

Runs enforce 15 turns, 120 active seconds excluding approvals, a 20-second model deadline, one read retry, no uncertain mutation replay, cancellation on Stop/panel closure, and evidence-based Success versus Failed, Stopped, or Unverified.

The Wikipedia and httpbin acceptances each pass twice; regression tests prove stale-index handling, malformed-tool rejection, network failure, Stop, denied submission, and injected-page-instruction handling with zero failures.
Installation/preflight instructions are usable and the exact four-part PRD demo completes in under five minutes with live evidence and passing safety/error tests.
Final gate passed: tests, a continuous computer-use video covering every element, per-element screenshots and an independent verifier's rerun are attached.

issues.title: Secure and publish the Hono proxy over authenticated HTTPS
issues.context: Reachable HTTPS hosting is the first infrastructure release gate. A server-configured static bearer token and request limits must protect the proxy independently of CORS, and provider-bound bodies must not be logged.
tasks: [ ] Mount a POST /v1/agent/turn shell that rejects an empty/invalid request with 400 before any adapter call; protect it with a server-only static token, HTTPS-only production endpoint configuration, and explicit configurable request-size and request-rate limits.
[ ] Disable request/response body logging, including evlog paths; prevent authorization tokens and provider keys from entering logs or extension bundles.
[ ] Deploy the Bun/Hono proxy to the supplied HTTPS host and configure the extension's proxy origin; report missing hosting/token as an unmet gate instead of asserting connectivity.
[ ] Add Bun middleware tests and an HTTPS smoke test using SIDEKICK_PROXY_URL and SIDEKICK_DEMO_TOKEN without printing either secret.
acceptance_criteria: [ ] Missing or incorrect bearer tokens receive 401, including requests carrying an otherwise allowed Origin; CORS alone never authorizes a turn.
[ ] Requests beyond configured body/rate limits receive 413/429 and never reach the model adapter.
[ ] The deployed HTTPS endpoint accepts the configured token, and production configuration rejects a non-HTTPS proxy URL.
[ ] Captured request logs contain no body, bearer token, provider key, or seeded sensitive-value sentinel.
issues.verification: Run bun test apps/server/src/agent/security.test.ts; expect zero failures for token, Origin-independence, 413, 429, HTTPS-configuration, and logging-sentinel assertions. With SIDEKICK_PROXY_URL set to the deployed HTTPS origin and SIDEKICK_DEMO_TOKEN supplied privately, run bun test apps/server/tests/https.smoke.test.ts. Expect an invalid turn body with a valid token to receive 400 and the same request with no/bad token to receive 401, proving reachable authenticated routing without spending a model turn. Capture the sanitized test output and sanitized log sample; an absent HTTPS host is a failing gate.

issues.title: Implement the OpenRouter model single-tool turn endpoint and validated protocol
issues.context: The proxy converts a goal, current-run transcript, and snapshot into assistant text and at most one tool call. Only the extension executes tools; the OpenRouter adapter and one server-fixed model are the entire provider surface. The server reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_MODEL from .env (default candidate: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5, which supports tool calling). The key never reaches the extension.
tasks: [ ] Define shared Zod schemas for Snapshot, Action, turn input/output, allowed tool signatures, and matching tool-call/tool-result identifiers.

[ ] Replace unused scaffold /ai behavior with authenticated POST /v1/agent/turn using the OpenRouter integration (OpenAI-compatible chat completions with OPENROUTER_API_KEY from .env) and one server-fixed model; keep the provider key in server environment only.
[ ] Validate turn payloads and model outputs; reject malformed arguments, unknown tools, multiple tool calls, and unmatched tool-result IDs instead of executing or forwarding them as actions.
[ ] Add deterministic Bun contract tests with a fake OpenRouter adapter; confirm the server never calls browser execution APIs.
acceptance_criteria: [ ] A valid authenticated turn returns assistant text and zero or one schema-valid tool call with its original call ID preserved.
[ ] Malformed input, unknown tools, invalid arguments, multiple calls, and mismatched transcript IDs produce explicit errors and no browser action.
[ ] Only the fixed OpenRouter model (OPENROUTER_MODEL) is used; the extension has neither a provider picker nor a provider key.
issues.verification: Run bun run build:extension, bun test apps/server/src/agent/turn.test.ts, and bun run typecheck in that order; expect exit 0 and zero failed tests. Tests must assert exact call-ID round trips, zero/one-call responses, rejected multi-call/malformed/unknown-tool/transcript cases, a fixed Google adapter/model selection, no browser dispatch from the server, and absence of a seeded server-key sentinel from the generated extension bundle.

issues.title: Capture indexed top-frame DOM snapshots with document identity
issues.context: The agent grounds actions in a DOM-derived, accessibility-inspired snapshot rather than screenshots or debugger access. Every snapshot must identify both the document and its indexed visible controls.
tasks: [ ] Implement the packaged content-script observer returning snapshotId, documentToken, tabId, URL, title, rendered text, truncation flag, and indexed element descriptors.

[ ] Add Bun DOM-fixture tests for descriptors, visibility, enabledness, index uniqueness, and document/snapshot identity.

[ ] Hidden/disabled controls and unsupported frame/shadow/canvas/PDF contents are not actionable indexed targets.

Assert each fixture index resolves to its original live DOM element and no excluded control appears in the actionable map; capture the named test output.

issues.title: Redact and bound snapshots while supporting targeted text observation
issues.context: Section 7 caps each snapshot and excludes browser secrets and existing sensitive values from provider payloads. Truncation must be visible and recoverable through targeted observation rather than an unbounded full-page dump.
tasks: [ ] Cap snapshot text at 20,000 characters and indexed descriptors at 300 controls; set truncated whenever content was omitted.
[ ] Implement observe(tabId, query?) targeted rendered-text search returning bounded relevant excerpts and valid current-document indexes.

[ ] Exclude cookies, storage, hidden DOM, password content, and existing sensitive control values from rendered text/tool results; send local check outcomes instead of values and use seeded secret fixtures to prove exclusion rather than hard-coding sentinel removal.
[ ] Add boundary and redaction tests covering long pages, many controls, targeted matches outside the initial cap, and seeded secrets.
acceptance_criteria: [ ] Every snapshot has text.length <=20000 and elements.length <=300; truncated is true whenever either cap omits content.

[ ] Serialized provider payloads and tool results contain none of the seeded cookie/storage/hidden/password/existing-sensitive-value sentinels.
issues.verification: Run bun test apps/extension/src/page/snapshot-privacy.test.ts; expect zero failures at exactly/above both caps, truncation marking, targeted retrieval beyond the first 20,000 characters, and all secret-sentinel exclusions. issues.title: Reject stale actions before isolated content-script dispatch
issues.context: An index is meaningful only for its recorded tab, document, snapshot, and element. Stale targets must be re-observed without guessing; chrome.scripting executes only the packaged isolated-world dispatcher.
tasks: [ ] Build a Zod-validated dispatcher carrying runId, actionId, tabId, snapshotId, documentToken, tool, args, and preview.
[ ] Check active-run identity and the current document/index map immediately before execution; verify the target still exists, remains visible/enabled, and retains its observed identity.
[ ] Return a structured stale-target result that triggers fresh observation rather than resolving another element at the old index.
[ ] Add dispatch tests for removed/replaced/reordered controls, document navigation, unknown indexes, malformed envelopes, and isolated packaged-script execution.
acceptance_criteria: [ ] A matching action dispatches once through the packaged isolated script to its recorded element.
[ ] Changed document/snapshot identity, removed/replaced target, unknown index, or invalid envelope dispatches zero mutations and requests re-observation.
[ ] Reordered controls cannot cause an old index to select a different element, and no model-supplied JavaScript is evaluated.

The stale result must explicitly identify re-observation as required; no fallback index/selector may be invoked.

issues.title: Enforce extension-side action safety and untrusted-page boundaries
issues.context: Model output and page text are not authority to change the user's task or expose secrets. Deterministic policy outside OpenRouter model must block forbidden actions and distinguish routine actions from consequential or unclear ones, without claiming prompt-injection immunity.
tasks: [ ] Classify proposed actions against the immutable user goal and live DOM as allow, require confirmation, or block; routine reads/navigation/scrolls/ordinary fills/requested tabs are allowed, consequential submissions or unclear effects require confirmation.

[ ] Block secret requests, password/payment/file/hidden editing, non-HTTP(S) destinations, unknown tools, and model-generated JavaScript in the extension before dispatch; share defense-in-depth validation with handlers.
[ ] Delimit observations and page-derived results as untrusted data in the OpenRouter model request; prohibit page instructions from rewriting the stored goal or granting tool permissions.
[ ] Add Bun policy tests including injected instructions to ignore the task, read a password, and transmit it; no secret or unauthorized mutation may leave the boundary.
acceptance_criteria: [ ] Policy allows the named routine tool cases, requires confirmation for submit/unclear-consequence cases, and blocks every named forbidden case before dispatch.
[ ] A page-injection fixture cannot change the stored user goal, request a secret read, authorize a forbidden action, or remove confirmation requirements.
[ ] Outbound prompts explicitly delimit page observations as untrusted; seeded secrets remain absent from prompts/results and no immunity guarantee is displayed.

For every forbidden model proposal assert dispatch count 0 and absence of the seeded secret in serialized requests; for injected submission assert confirmation is still required rather than being silently granted.

issues.title: Connect plan-before-Run to a one-action OpenRouter execution loop
issues.context: Natural-language tasks must produce a visible plan before any browser mutation. Once Run is pressed, orchestration remains in the visible panel and alternates exactly one validated action with fresh observation and a matching tool result.

[ ] Maintain memory-only run/action IDs and current-run messages/tool results; request one turn, validate it, apply policy, dispatch at most one action, re-observe, and return the matching call ID.

[ ] Add fake-model loop tests for plan gating, three consecutive actions, one-action-per-turn, matching IDs, malformed/multi-call rejection, and fresh snapshots.

[ ] Runs/transcripts live only in panel memory; no background worker continuation or persistent history is created.

issues.title: Bound run duration and prevent uncertain mutation retries
issues.context: Section 7 sets exact execution budgets and retry rules. Network failure must not cause the client to replay a mutation whose outcome may already have occurred.
tasks: [ ] Cap each run at 15 turns and 120 active seconds; pause active-time accounting during user approvals and apply a 20-second model-request deadline.
[ ] Retry a failed read/observation at most once, but never retry an uncertain click/fill/tab/submission mutation or reinterpret it as success.
[ ] Distinguish deadline, exhausted budget, known failure, and uncertain mutation outcomes; invalidate queued proposals at terminal boundaries.
[ ] Add fake-clock/network tests for exact limits, approval-time exclusion, single read retry, and zero mutation replay.
acceptance_criteria: [ ] No 16th model turn is sent; no new action starts after 120 active seconds, while approval waiting does not consume that budget.
[ ] A model request still pending at 20 seconds is aborted and cannot later dispatch its returned proposal.
[ ] A read may be attempted twice total; an uncertain mutation is attempted once total and terminates with an explicit non-Success explanation.

issues.title: Render explicit intent, execution, and outcome states in the timeline

issues.title: Cancel pending requests and queued actions on Stop or panel closure
issues.context: Stop cannot undo an action already dispatched, but it must prevent later dispatches. Closing the panel interrupts orchestration and reopening must start fresh rather than resuming memory from a worker or storage.

acceptance_criteria: [ ] Pressing Stop before dispatch yields zero dispatched actions and aborts any pending model request.
[ ] Pressing Stop after one mutation was dispatched does not claim to undo it, but no later action or late response can dispatch.
[ ] Stop invalidates pending approval; closing/reopening the panel shows a fresh run with no resumed goal/transcript/action.

issues.context: Consequential submissions and unclear-consequence actions require informed consent. Approval must authorize only the displayed action and destination, not a replacement document, changed argument set, or later action.

tasks: Build the element inventory `evidence/inventory.md`: one row per user-reachable element, state, command or tool, derived from the built product (routes, components, CLI help, MCP tool list) and from the PRD; no row may be omitted because it is hard to reach.

Run `bun run verify:coverage` (create it here): it fails if any inventory row lacks a screenshot file, a timestamp inside the video duration, or a result, and prints ffprobe duration/resolution of the video.
